approach: The fault is in `Drain::attempts` (crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs:1810-1818). After the second failure it asks `paused_reason`, which goes through `Steps::paused` to `Athena::line_pause`. That function returns only `Level::Pause` marks (scope_guard.rs:782-790), so a line that is only flagged returns `None` and the item ends as `ItemEnd::Failed`, which stops the batch (drain.rs:2392). The plan adds three pieces. (1) `Athena::line_flag` in scope_guard.rs: the line's stored flag mark, returned only while the recomputed level still holds a flag, mirroring `line_pause` and the `holds` rule of `live_marks`. (2) A defaulted `Steps::flagged(&self, jobs) -> Vec<(String, String)>` in drain.rs, with the same shape as `paused` and an empty default. `RealSteps` implements it with `line_flag` plus a note text built from the mark's signal names and reason. (3) At the ATTEMPTS point, after `paused_reason` returns `None`, the drain asks `flagged_reason`. A flagged line returns the new `ItemEnd::Flagged(reason)`, which `finish` handles like `Paused` through `pass_over`, so it prints one `plan       <id> passed over: line <line> is flagged (T1, T3, T5): …` line and sets no stop. An item on neither a flagged nor a paused line still returns `ItemEnd::Failed`. The flag is not consulted before the first or second attempt, so a flagged line still gets its two attempts; only the end-of-attempts decision changes. No pause file is written and no record changes. The docs (module docs lines 26-33, `Stop::RepeatedFailure` doc at 943-946, `Stop::meaning` at 1004), the `athena drain --help` stop-reasons text (main.rs:254) and CHANGELOG are updated. One existing real-steps test, at tests/drain.rs:4534, asserted the old behavior for a flagged line, so it is updated.

decisions.choice: Add `Athena::line_flag(records, job_id) -> Option<LineMark>` in scope_guard.rs, with the same lookup path as `line_pause`. It reads `flag_path(first)` and requires the recomputed `line_state(..).2.overall() >= Level::Flag`.
decisions.reason: The drain knows an item's job id, not its line's first request id, and `live_marks` is keyed by line. `line_pause` already maps job to line to file to recomputed level (scope_guard.rs:782-790). A flag file the watcher has not yet removed but the records no longer support is not honoured, as `live_marks` does at 803-811.

rejected.option: Call `live_marks` from RealSteps and match marks by job
rejected.why: A mark's `line` is the first request id and a later job of the line (a retry job) is not equal to it, so the match would need `group_lines` again in the CLI crate, whose helpers are private to scope_guard.rs.

rejected.option: Treat only the stored flag file as truth, with no recompute
rejected.why: A stale flag would pass an item over wrongly; the recompute is the same safeguard `line_pause` has.

decisions.choice: New defaulted `Steps::flagged` method, a sibling of `Steps::paused`, with an empty default. A new `ItemEnd::Flagged(String)` ends the item, and `finish` passes it over.
decisions.reason: A new defaulted method leaves the other `Steps` impls (Unaccepted, Replay, WithRealCheck, Shared, Rebasing and the unit-test stubs in drain.rs) compiling and behaving as before. The existing `Paused` path is the template, and the new text names the flag signals. `Steps::paused` doc says it feeds the plan hold at `prepare`, so flags must not go through it or flagged items would be held back before their first attempt.

rejected.why: `prepare` (drain.rs:1978-1990) would hold flagged items out of the plan before any attempt, and `athena plan` would list them as held. That changes the plan, a wider change than the request.
It works, but a separate variant keeps the two causes distinguishable in code and docs at no cost; both arms call `pass_over`.

rejected.option: Write a real pause file for a line that fails twice while flagged
rejected.why: The scope guard's thresholds and when it records a pause are out of scope; the drain should not write scope state.

decisions.choice: Consult the flag only at the ATTEMPTS decision (after the second failure), not before each attempt.
decisions.reason: The request is to pause after two failures. A flagged line is still dispatched for its attempts (the flag's own lift text says 'the line is still dispatched').

rejected.option: Also check the flag before each attempt
rejected.why: It would skip flagged items entirely, which changes the flag semantics the user did not ask to change.

decisions.choice: Update the existing real-steps test `drain_real_steps_do_not_hold_an_item_for_a_stored_pause_that_no_longer_holds` (tests/drain.rs:4534). Its first assertion becomes `failed_item == None` and `stop != RepeatedFailure`, because that line is flagged by two rejections of different criteria. The rest of the test, the stale-pause check, stays.
decisions.reason: The old assertion `failed_item == Some(job)` encodes the behavior this change removes. The rest of the test checks stale pauses and keeps its meaning.

rejected.option: Leave the test and add a fixture that avoids the flag
rejected.why: It would fail as is; the behavior changes by design.

files.purpose: Add `Athena::line_flag(records, job_id)`, which returns the line's flag mark while the recomputed level still holds a flag. Add `Athena::flag_note(mark)`, a one-line text of the form `line <id> is flagged (<signals>): <reason>`. Update the module docs near lines 14-21 to mention the drain's use. Add a unit test.

Add `Steps::flagged` (empty default), `Drain::flagged_reason`, `ItemEnd::Flagged`, the ATTEMPTS-point check and the `finish` arm, and the `RealSteps::flagged` impl using `line_flag` and `flag_note`. Update the module docs (26-33), the `Stop::RepeatedFailure` doc (943-946), `Stop::meaning` (1004) and the comment in `Drain::attempts`.
Update the `repeated failure` line of the stop reasons in the drain help text (line 254) to say a flagged or paused item is passed over.
Add `flagged` to the `Stub` and its `Steps::flagged` impl, a `flag_text` helper, the new flagged test, the unflagged-still-stops twin, and a real-steps flagged test. Update the test at line 4534.
Add a Fixed bullet after the paused-line entry (line 170-175) citing the 3 Nov 11:13pm UTC incident and item 20261103-193428-df2m.

steps: In crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs, add `Athena::line_flag(&self, records: &Records, job_id: &str) -> Option<LineMark>` next to `line_pause` (after line 790). It uses the same request, line and first-id lookup, reads `flag_path(&self.state, first)` with `read_mark`, drops it if `is_pause()`, and returns it only while `line_state(..).2.overall() >= Level::Flag`. Add `Athena::flag_note(&self, mark: &LineMark) -> String` returning `line {line} is flagged ({signal_names}): {reason}`. Add a unit test in the existing watcher tests, modelled on the `line_pause` tests near 1281-1512: a flagged line returns its mark, a clean line returns None, and a paused line returns None.

In crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, add `fn flagged(&self, _jobs: &[String]) -> Vec<(String, String)> { Vec::new() }` to `Steps` after `paused` (line 654), documented as: which of the jobs are on a line the scope guard has only flagged, each with the reason; asked only after an item's last failed attempt and never before a read, so a flagged line is still dispatched.

Add `ItemEnd::Flagged(String)` next to `ItemEnd::Paused` (line 1292). Add `Drain::flagged_reason(&self, item)` beside `paused_reason` (1823). Change the ATTEMPTS block (1810-1818): on `failures >= ATTEMPTS` return `Paused(reason)` if `paused_reason` finds one, else `Flagged(reason)` if `flagged_reason` finds one, else `Failed`. Add the `ItemEnd::Flagged(reason) => self.pass_over(&item.job, &reason)` arm in `finish` (near line 2426).

Implement `Steps::flagged` for `RealSteps` (near line 3339): load records (an empty Vec when they cannot load) and map each job through `self.athena.line_flag(&records, job)` to `(job, self.athena.flag_note(&mark))`.

Update the docs: the module bullet at lines 26-33 (add that a line flagged and not paused is also passed over after the second failed attempt, with the flag signals as the reason, and that nothing is written), the `Stop::RepeatedFailure` doc (943-946), `Stop::meaning` for RepeatedFailure (1004), and the comment in `Drain::attempts`. Update the `repeated failure` stop-reason line in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs (line 254) the same way.

In crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs, add the `flagged: Vec<(&'static str, &'static str)>` field to `Stub` (after `paused`, line 91) and a `flagged` method on `impl Steps for Stub` (after line 168) that filters configured entries by the asked jobs. Add a `flag_text(line)` helper beside `pause_text` (line 553): `line {line} is flagged (T1, T3, T5): ...`. Add the tests: (a) `drain_passes_over_an_item_that_fails_twice_on_a_flagged_line_and_runs_the_next_item`, which asserts the log, stop, `failed_item`, landed count, the single passed-over line and its position, and the report text; (b) `drain_still_stops_on_repeated_failure_when_another_item_is_flagged_but_this_one_is_not`; (c) a real-steps test `drain_real_steps_pass_over_the_item_of_a_line_that_is_flagged_after_two_failures`, using `rejected_twice(rejecting_verdict(), rejecting_second_criterion())` and `steps.flagged`.

Update `drain_real_steps_do_not_hold_an_item_for_a_stored_pause_that_no_longer_holds` (tests/drain.rs:4534-4540): replace `assert_eq!(first.failed_item.as_deref(), Some(job.as_str()))` with `assert_eq!(first.failed_item, None)` and `assert_ne!(first.stop, Stop::RepeatedFailure)`, with a comment that the flagged line is now passed over. Keep the rest.

Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet under Unreleased / Fixed after line 175: a batch no longer stops as a repeated failure when the failed item's line is flagged and not paused; on 3 Nov at 11:13pm UTC a batch stopped with money and slots left because item 20261103-193428-df2m was flagged (T1, T3, T5); root cause: the stop check after the last failed attempt asked only for a pause, and `line_pause` returns only pauses; the item is now passed over with the flag reason and the next item runs; an item whose line is neither flagged nor paused that fails twice still stops the batch.

Run `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`, `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard` and `cargo test --locked`; fix what fails.

risks.risk: A flagged item that keeps failing is tried (two attempts) again on each later drain run, because the flag is consulted only after the second failure and nothing is written. That spends money each run.
risks.mitigation: Flags are rare and the pass-over is logged with the signals, so the operator sees it. It is the requested behavior. The flag lift text already says the line is still dispatched, and the item stays queued and is visible in `report.queued`.

risks.risk: `line_flag` might read a stale flag file and pass an item over that should stop the batch.
risks.mitigation: Mirror `line_pause` (same lookup, same recompute) and add a unit test for a flag that no longer holds. `RealSteps::flagged` returns an empty list when records cannot load, as `paused` does, which falls back to the old repeated-failure stop.

risks.risk: A line has both a pause file and a flag file, so the item could be reported with the wrong text.
risks.mitigation: `paused_reason` is checked first and its result wins. `line_flag` ignores pause marks (`filter(!is_pause)`) and the `try_watch_line` writer removes the flag file when it writes a pause.

risks.risk: Another existing test unknowingly relies on a flagged line failing twice and stopping the batch.
risks.mitigation: Grep found only tests/drain.rs:4534 asserting a flagged-line failure, and it is updated. `cargo test --locked` is the check, as required for criterion 4.

risks.risk: Size: five files touched. That is a design choice, not extra scope, because the docs and help text carry the stop rule.
risks.mitigation: Keep the producer's diff to the five listed files and treat the docs, the help text and the changelog as part of the same change.

demonstrations.method: New test using the `Stub` Steps double. `Stub` gets a new field `flagged: Vec<(&'static str, &'static str)>` and a `Steps::flagged` impl that returns the configured pairs whose job is in the asked list. Items `a`, `b`; outcomes Rejected, Rejected, Landed; `flagged: vec![("a", flag_text("a"))]` and no pause. It calls `drain::drain(&stub, limits(9.0), &ui)` with the `Stamped` Ui.
demonstrations.observes: `stub.log()` equals `[read a, run a, reread a, run a-retry, read b, run b, land b, rate]`. `report.stop` is `QueueEmpty` and not `RepeatedFailure`. `report.failed_item` is `None`. `report.landed` is 1. `report.jobs` holds `b` as run and landed.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the `flagged` consult at the ATTEMPTS point, `a` ends as `ItemEnd::Failed`, `report.stop` is `Stop::RepeatedFailure`, `report.failed_item` is `Some("a")`, and the log never contains `read b`/`run b`/`land b`, so the test fails.
